features.name: red orange lava floor
features.quote: A large lava floor covering the entire 2048x2048 base at Y=0, glowing red-orange neon material

features.name: cyan start platform
features.quote: A start platform at one corner where players begin, bright cyan neon

features.name: zigzag platform track
features.notes: 10 floating platforms across the map; varying sizes and heights; gaps of 10-20 studs
features.quote: 10 floating platforms of varying sizes and heights arranged in a zigzag path across the map

features.name: multicolor neon platforms
features.notes: One each in magenta, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, white, teal, and lime
features.quote: each a different neon color (magenta, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, pink, white, teal, lime)

features.name: rising varied platform heights
features.quote: Heights should gradually increase then vary

features.name: neon gradient ramps
features.quote: 2 ramps connecting some platforms, neon gradient style

features.name: dark glowing obstacle walls
features.quote: 2 obstacle walls that players must jump around, dark neon with glowing edges

features.name: golden checkpoint platforms
features.notes: 4 platforms placed at intervals along the path
features.quote: 4 checkpoint platforms placed at intervals along the path, golden neon with a glowing ring or marker

features.name: checkpoint glowing rings
features.notes: One ring or marker on each checkpoint platform
features.quote: each marked by a glowing ring

features.name: green finish platform
features.quote: A finish platform at the far corner, bright green neon with a celebration feel

features.name: flat horizontal course layout
features.notes: Course progresses horizontally across the ground
features.quote: Flat Course: A course laid out across the ground, progressing horizontally

features.name: vibrant futuristic neon style
features.quote: The overall style should be vibrant, glowing, futuristic neon
